tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background and the default ground behind the logo.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised areas: cards, panels, video tiles, input fills.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers between surfaces. Never the only thing that marks a control.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: The logo's own ink (#2d292d, sampled from the mark). Headlines and body copy on paper, surface and spin-soft (12:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata and timestamps on paper, surface and spin-soft (4.6:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: spin
tokens.usage: The accent. Fills only: primary buttons, the play/progress bar, active states, highlight blocks. Put on-spin text on it; never set spin itself as body text.

tokens.name: on-spin
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a spin fill (4.8:1 light, 6.0:1 dark). Dark in both themes on purpose; white on spin fails contrast.

tokens.name: spin-text
tokens.usage: The accent as text: links, inline emphasis, small accent labels on paper, surface and spin-soft (4.6:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: spin-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background for callouts, selected rows and tags. Pair with ink or spin-text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring with a 2px offset on every interactive element; holds 3:1 on paper and surface in both themes.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero lines and campaign headlines. One per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: How we shot this in one take
styles.usage: Card and video titles, dialog titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Upload once and kinetube handles the rest.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Metadata, captions, helper text; usually in ink-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase tags, badges and overlines. Short words only.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls and between stacked small text.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button padding (vertical 12, horizontal 20), list item gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding and grid gutters on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Grid gutters on desktop, gap between sections inside a card.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space between page sections; minimum logo clear space at standard sizes.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, video tiles, dialogs, image blocks.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, avatars and the app-icon disc. Kinetube controls are pills, echoing the round mark.
